lines.zh: 我是一个三明治，一步一步挪。
lines.en: I am a sandwich, moving step by step.
I walk along carrying my lettuce.

lines.zh: 我摇摇摆摆地穿过草地。
lines.en: I wobble across the grass.

lines.zh: 我的面包片一上一下地颠。
lines.en: My bread slices bob up and down.
I head for that house.
I go around a puddle.
I squeeze through a very narrow door.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可没人拦得住。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but nothing stops me.
I sway as I walk.
I head down the path to the door.
I step across a fallen leaf.

lines.zh: 我停下来，面包歪了一下。
lines.en: I stop and my bread tilts.
I wobble on my way again.
I shuffle toward the people.
I round the corner of the wall.
I shift slowly up to the steps.
I stand with my lettuce drooping.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一份午饭。
lines.en: I hold still like someone's lunch.
My bread slices sway slowly.
I face the sun.
I hear sounds from a kitchen.
I just stand; nothing else.
A little sauce is running down me.
I rotate slowly onto my side.
A bird is watching me.
I set myself upright.
I bob once more.
I wait for someone to come.
I stay where I am.
The wind moves my lettuce.
I shift my balance.
I am still a sandwich.

lines.zh: 我把正面转过来对着你。
lines.en: I turn my front to you.
You have watched me a long while.
I tip slowly.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，可我在看你。
lines.en: I have no eyes, but I am looking at you.
You are not planning to eat me, are you.
I shift a step backwards.
I wobble, which is my answer.
You reach out and I shy away.
I stop in front of you.
Staring like that is rude.
I shift to the side.
I come to a stop again.
My bread is squashed.
I tip over to one side.
A leaf of lettuce falls.
Sauce leaks out.
I wobble a long time before steadying.
I right myself.
I am still a sandwich.
I press that grudge into my bread.
I edge away by degrees.
The two slices still hold together.
I do not eat; I am what is eaten.

lines.zh: 你把面包举起来，我有点慌。
lines.en: You hold up bread and I panic a little.
That is not for me to eat.
I back off several steps.
I wobble to say no.

lines.zh: 你把生菜递过来，我看了看。
lines.en: You offer lettuce and I look at it.
These do not help me.
I slip around the side of your hand.

lines.zh: 我保住自己的面包就好。
lines.en: I only need to keep my own bread.
I stand farther off.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在地上，我在旁边看。
lines.en: You set it on the ground and I look on.
I think it over and walk off.
I tilt toward it.

lines.zh: 这东西会弄脏我的面包。
lines.en: That would mess up my bread.
I ease back to the wall.
I rock once, which means no.
You knock my bread askew.

lines.zh: 我晃了好几下才正回来。
lines.en: I wobble several times before righting.
A leaf of my lettuce falls.
I cannot pick it up.
I give way to the side.

lines.zh: 我这么软，撞一下就变形。
lines.en: I am soft; one bump reshapes me.
You bumped me again.
I stand askew for a moment.
I set myself straight slowly.
Stop knocking into my bread.
I am a sandwich.
I cannot do that.
I wobble to show I do not understand.
I shift aside.

lines.zh: 两片面包靠在一起也没用。
lines.en: Two slices of bread together would not help.
I stand here with no other intention.
I set myself in order.
I turn half around, back first.
I go on my way as before.
I said not a word.
I cannot bend to pick it up.
I touch it with the crust.
I cannot tuck that into myself.
I balance it on my bread.
It slid off.
I reach for it once more.
It caught in my lettuce.
It is still there; I leave it.
I turn toward it.
I shuffle on.
Something is shifting.
I face that way.
I have it wedged in my eye.
Maybe I should not go over.
I went over in the end.
My bread bobs as I move.
It has not spotted me.
I close in slowly.
I stand there and watch.
I square myself and wait.
I face it squarely.
It moves and so do I.
It looks back and I stop.
A few steps still separate us.
My lettuce keeps swaying.
I hold this distance.
It does not seem afraid of me.
I stand a while longer.
I am not certain what to do.
I throw my whole self at it.
I butt it once.

lines.zh: 我的面包边磕在它身上。
lines.en: My crust knocks against it.
That ram was limp and weak.
It pushes and I go askew.
I butt with my crust again.
I am bounced off to one side.
I land on the ground and my bread comes apart.
I slowly put myself back together.
I suppose I have fought.
I rise up off the ground.
I am a chicken sandwich.
The grass grows well here.
I look all around.
The wind lifts my lettuce.
I shift toward that house.
My bread is still warm.
I take a step and stop.
No one made me to be eaten.
I scrape forward step by step.
The crust of my bread burns.

lines.zh: 我落地时散了架，又拼起来。
lines.en: I come apart on landing and reassemble.
The bread soaks soft and I sink.

lines.zh: 炸风把我掀翻，生菜飞了出去。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my lettuce flies off.

lines.zh: 有东西扎穿了我的面包。
lines.en: Something pierces my bread.
Strange force flattens me.

lines.zh: 没人吃我，我有点变质了。
lines.en: No one eats me and I am going off.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的面包全黑了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my bread goes black.

lines.zh: 我一路往下掉，散成了几片。
lines.en: I fall away, coming apart into pieces.
